{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge knit top: fitted, boat neckline, long sleeves, cropped at the waist, ivory #F4EDE0, merino-silk blend
Pleated skirt: A-line, mid-calf length, emerald #0B6E4F, satin-finish crepe
Sheer tights: close-fitting, 20 denier, black #1A1A1A, nylon-elastane
Coat (outer layer for the cool autumn evening): single-breasted, slightly shaped, knee length, deep ink navy #1B2A4A, brushed wool
Ankle boots: pointed toe, mid block heel, black #1C1C21, smooth suede
Drop earrings: slim linear shape, polished silver #C0C4CC, sterling silver
Clutch: small envelope shape, pewter #9EA3AD, metallic leather

This outfit stays within a neat theatre dress code but makes the emerald skirt the statement. Its pleats catch the light and move as you walk, which stands out under the foyer's artificial lighting. Emerald flatters your fair, cool-toned skin and silvery hair, and the ivory knit brings brightness near your face so your blue eyes stand out. The navy coat and black boots keep the look polished and warm for an autumn evening, while the silver accessories echo your hair and add a quiet shine."}
